readmeHtml:
Home Assistant

Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first. Powered by a worldwide community of tinkerers and DIY enthusiasts. Perfect to run on a Raspberry Pi or a local server.

Check out home-assistant.io for a demo, installation instructions, tutorials and documentation.

Featured integrations

The system is built using a modular approach so support for other devices or actions can be implemented easily. See also the section on architecture and the section on creating your own components.

If you run into issues while using Home Assistant or during development of a component, check the Home Assistant help section of our website for further help and information.

aiSummary.oneLiner: Open source home automation that puts local control and privacy first.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Home Assistant is a Python-based open-source home automation platform. It focuses on local control and privacy, ensuring your data stays securely in your home network. The system integrates smoothly with thousands of smart devices and cloud services out of the box. It offers a powerful automation engine to connect and orchestrate entirely different devices. The highly modular architecture allows for extensive customization and self-hosting without ever relying on external cloud services.
keyFeatures: Local control: Processes operations completely locally without requiring a persistent active internet connection.
Privacy first: Stores data strictly locally and never sends it to external servers without explicit user permission.
Extensive integration: Supports thousands of diverse smart home devices and services natively from various vendors.
Automation engine: Allows users to create highly complex automations and dynamic scenes based on various triggers.
Self-hosted: Deploys robustly on various hardware platforms like a Raspberry Pi, local servers, or NAS devices.
Open source: Maintained fully open-source and community-driven, ensuring absolute transparency and continuous improvement.

useCases.title: Privacy focused setup
useCases.description: Manage diverse smart devices locally without exposing highly sensitive personal data to external cloud services.

useCases.title: Device consolidation
useCases.description: Control disparate smart home ecosystems natively from different manufacturers securely in a single, unified interface.

useCases.title: Energy management
useCases.description: Monitor and proactively optimize electricity consumption continuously across various connected major household appliances.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: DIY enthusiasts, makers, and anyone seeking a privacy-focused smart home setup. It requires basic technical knowledge for setup, but offers advanced capabilities for power users.
